note: Registry data could not be verified. The DuckDuckGo search backend returned connection errors ('Connection refused') for all queries, and direct registry sources were inaccessible: zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, instafinancials.com returned HTTP 404, tofler.in search returned 404, quickcompany.in returned 404. Google and Bing HTML endpoints returned no usable results for the exact-name queries (Bing returned unrelated content). Therefore CIN/LLPIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered-office state, MCA status and audited revenue for FY25/FY26 are all reported as null - NOT because they do not exist, but because no public source could be read in this session. No entity-existence conclusion is drawn and the company is NOT rejected: per project rules rejection requires positive evidence of non-existence/strike-off/liquidation/bankruptcy, which was not obtained. Role is left 'unknown' - the declared HS codes (400912, 400931, 400932, 401693 - rubber tubing/hoses and gaskets) do not by themselves establish manufacturer vs trader status, and the claimed industry 'Aviation & transport' is unconfirmed. Note also that the declared HS codes are rubber-component codes, not aircraft/aviation HS codes; per rule 3 this is not a rejection ground and would only warrant an HS correction once actual shipment data is available. Recommended next step: re-run verification when search access is restored, or query MCA master data / GST public search directly by name.
